projects.title: Theft Alert
projects.summary: Chromium MV3 extension + Flutter companion that detects phishing in real time. Reputation, WHOIS, SSL and heuristics with Gemini assistance and deterministic guardrails.
projects.problem: Phishing pages mimic trusted brands faster than blocklists update. Users need instant, explainable risk assessment in the browser and on mobile.
architecture: FastAPI scores URL via heuristics + reputation feeds
WHOIS / SSL / DOM signals normalized to 0–100
Flutter companion mirrors alerts via WebSockets
decisions: Gemini used as assist, never oracle — deterministic fallback always returns
Score normalization explained in UI, no black-box verdict
limitations: Reputation feeds rate-limited; offline mode heuristic-only
Zero-day domains still rely on heuristics
Store review pending — labelled Prototype unless confirmed

projects.title: EduPortal
projects.summary: Campus OS: student, faculty and admin roles covering schedules, exams, news, library vault, chat/polls/pins, push, PWA/TWA and Flutter companion.
projects.problem: Academic operations were split across sheets, WhatsApp and notice boards. Needed one trusted surface with offline-capable access.
architecture: PWA with background sync, TWA wrapper
decisions: TWA for Play Store without rewriting
Pinned notices treated as first-class objects
limitations: Push relies on FCM / Web Push availability
Offline writes queue, conflict resolution manual
Scale tested to cohort size, not institution cluster yet

projects.title: ARIA
projects.summary: RAG assistant for PDF, YouTube and GitHub ingestion — embeddings, Chroma, semantic retrieval, memory and Groq/LangChain orchestration.
projects.problem: Teams learn from scattered PDFs, videos and repos. Needed one memory-aware assistant grounded in their own sources.
architecture: Query: embed → retrieval → Groq synthesis with citations
decisions: Strict citation framing; fallback to 'not found in sources'
limitations: Chunking heuristic for scanned PDFs is lossy
No fine-tuning — retrieval quality bounds answers

projects.title: Perkify
projects.summary: Perks & recommendations platform — Next.js + Express/JWT/Prisma/Postgres and a FastAPI assistant that assists without impersonating intelligence.
projects.problem: Benefits and perks discovery was generic and inauthentic. Needed contextual recommendations with honest labeling.
architecture: Next.js app, Express API with JWT/Prisma
decisions: Assistant isolated as microservice for independent scaling
limitations: Recommendation quality bounded by perk catalogue size
No trained ranking model — rules + embeddings only
Email deliverability via SMTP limits bursts

projects.title: Career Boost
projects.summary: Ananya's focused career companion: Supabase + document parsing, deterministic skill/match/interview/roadmap/portfolio logic. No trained ML claims.
projects.problem: Students paste résumés and get vague advice. Needed deterministic, auditable analysis from actual document content.
architecture: Deterministic scoring: skills, gap analysis, role match
decisions: No 'ML model' language — rules + heuristics only
limitations: Extraction fails on scanned images (OCR not yet in path)
Roadmap templates limited to tracked roles
Needs human review before real hiring signal

projects.title: The Local Way
projects.summary: Village discovery platform — stays, experiences, artisans and bookings. Editorial discovery, marketplace pragmatics.
projects.problem: Rural tourism and craft need a calm, trustworthy surface that respects hosts and doesn't overwhelm with neon travel patterns.
architecture: Booking hold + confirm flow (no payment in prototype)
Editorial cards with warm monochrome imagery
decisions: Booking is hold-based, not real payment in prototype
Map vs list toggle respects reduced motion
Content hierarchy driven by editorial, not algorithmic feed
limitations: Search is keyword, not semantic yet
